name: zcode-qwenwork-connect
description: Bring QwenWork (千问办公) desktop models — Qwen3.8-Flash, Pro, Qwen3.8-Max — into ZCode as an OpenAI-compatible provider, reusing the desktop app's own sign-in. Zero configuration, zero API keys.

description_i18n.en: Bring QwenWork (千问办公) desktop models into ZCode as an OpenAI-compatible provider, reusing the desktop app's own sign-in.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把千问办公(QwenWork)桌面 App 的模型(Qwen3.8-Flash、Pro、Qwen3.8-Max)复用桌面登录零配置接入 ZCode 的模型供应商。
